title: Amasezerano y'ikoreshwa
intro: Murakaza neza ku rubuga rwacu. Nyamuneka soma Amasezerano y'ikoreshwa neza mbere yo gukoresha serivisi zacu.
locationText: Urubuga rwacu rukoresha ibiranga ahantu mugutanga ibyerekezo ku bakerarugendo. Dufata ibiranga ahantu mugihe umuyobozi ari kwandikisha ibitemberwa, ntago duhora tureba aho waba uherereye.
translationText: Urubuga rwacu rukoresha gahunda yo guhindura indimi kugirango umuyobozi yegereze ibitemberwa abantu benshi. Uramenyeshwa ko hari igihe haba amakosa muguhindura indimi.
privacyText: Nyamuneka ntihagire ahantu nahamwe uzatanga  Do not share sensitive information such as passwords, personal identification numbers, or payment details anywhere.
dataSharingText: Amakuru ajyanye nawe ntaho tuzayatanga. Abayobozi babugenewe nibo bonyine bazabona amakuru ajyanye n'ibitemberwa wishimiye.
